blocks.text: The Application Investigation Overview page facilitates comprehensive visibility into the executable files and applications across your endpoints, enabling the detailed monitoring of software, processes, and libraries essential for security auditing, compliance, and threat identification.
The Overview page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Gain a clear view of all applications in use, including unauthorized AI tools and unapproved browsers.
Identify vulnerable or suspicious applications across your organization.
Prioritize security efforts by highlighting the highest threat application categories and vulnerabilities.

blocks.text: On the Overview page (Data Security > Endpoint DLP > Endpoint Data Scan > Application Investigation > Overview), you can view the following:

blocks.item: Detected Applications: The number of applications detected on Windows and macOS endpoints, the number of distinct applications, and the number of applications with CVE.
Instances by Code Signing Certificate Status: Distribution of application grouped by the code signing status (i.e., Valid Signature, Certificate Expired, Unsigned, Not Valid, or Invalid Signature).
Instances by Threat Type: A breakdown of application instances based on the application's threat types (i.e., Benign, Malicious, Suspicious, or Unknown).

Top Applications Versions with Vulnerabilities: Top applications with vulnerabilities are listed with their version numbers and the number of instances on the endpoints. You can filter data by the level of the vulnerability's severity (i.e., Low, Medium, High, or Critical). Click an application name or executable file to view details in a side drawer. To learn more, see Analyzing Application Details.

Top Applications by Category: Top applications found on devices can be viewed based on the application category, such as AI Assistance, Browsers, DBA Tools, Email Clients, File Sharing, Productivity Applications, Video Conference & Collaborations, and Windows Utilities. Click View All to view detailed information on the Application Investigation Inventory Page.

Top Applications with Threats: Top applications filtered by the threat type, (i.e., Suspicious or Malicious). Click View All to view detailed information on the Application Investigation Inventory Page.

The endpoint detects the application threat type by performing a local signature check to instantly verify applications from trusted providers. If a signature is unknown or compromised, ZDP automatically consults the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange, which cross-references the file against global threat feeds, proprietary intelligence, and an extensive sandbox history to determine a final safety verdict (Benign, Suspicious, Malicious, or Unknown).
Top Applications with Custom Certificate Trust Store: Top applications that maintain and use non-system certificate trust stores.

Top Applications by Number of Installed Versions: Applications are listed by the order of the number of installed versions. Click the application name or executable file to open a drawer that shows details of that application or executable file. To learn more, see Analyzing Application Details. Click View All to view detailed information on the Application Investigation Inventory Page.
Top AI Applications: The top AI applications and the number of instances. Click the displayed value to view detailed information in a drawer.
